title: Omnichannel Contacts: Tie Every Call and Text to a Person | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Every call, text and conversation needs to be tied to a person, or an agent answers a caller as a stranger. In the CrestApps Omnichannel, a contact keeps the person's name, phone numbers and email addresses, time zone and do-not-contact choices, and every activity links back to it.

In this video:
• Why contacts, and what a contact keeps
• Setting up the contact type: time zone and do-not-contact options, and the Contact Methods list
• Creating a contact with a phone number, time zone and preferences
• Finding a contact by name or phone number, and the phone search terms
• Working with a contact: list activities and add activities
• Import options for contacts, and exporting with the last activity
